summary: Updating an existing project (project/, the green end of spec-telem) to revision 2 of its spec (spec-v2.md), which adds a status message: a misspelt attribute in a condition, then an off-by-one offset, each fixed in its own loop run; the label, id, profile, parents and existing packet tests are kept.

runs.note: Before the runs, the loop ran once on the project as it is, green. Add the status report's battery field behind its msg_type, and a new packet test for example 3 of spec-v2.md; the existing tests stay as they are. The draft misspells msg_type and puts battery one byte too far.

edits.new:
- if: val(msgtype) == 3
    then:
      - {name: battery, type: MMT_U8_DATA, offset: 9}
  - name: readings

runs.note: model.unknown-attribute at the condition: the message suggests msg_type.
battery is absent: spec-v2.md puts it at offset 8, right after the 8-byte header, and a status report is 9 bytes long. Fix the model, not the test.
